description: Create README.md and a versioned experiment config describing the frozen experiment. Set DuckDB/SQLite both directions, single SELECT including WITH, joins, subqueries, aggregation, windows, set operations, CASE, casts, strings/date operations. Exclude DDL/DML/procedures/extensions/nondeterminism; define support before inspecting model outcomes. Fix timezone/collation/type mappings and deterministic ordering requirements, exclude LIMIT with ambiguous ties from gold cases with recorded reason. Specify source/target versions, schema and settings as inputs; SQL or explicit failure as output. Specify JSONL records for case ID, family/group ID, original source SQL, dialects, schema, fixture seeds, provenance, target candidate and validation status; no gold SQL in inference inputs. Define 1024-token limit and separately reported long-input population. Define commands prepare, validate, split, baseline, train, evaluate, report; each takes config and run-dir. This is documentation/config only, not seven commands at once. Document exact output filenames and how later tasks consume them.
